body:
Crazy Business Idea While on Focalin for the First Time
I am an experienced drug user. I prefer opioids or benzos but I also love the Gabapentin high. A friend had just gotten Focalin and I always wanted to try Ritalin or adderal so this was perfect. Im also on Suboxone.
My fiancé ( now husband A) was over and Id been doing a lot of Gabapentin and Suboxone together for awhile. Im prescribed 24mgs.  However this time I wanted to try just the Gabapentin and Focalin.
9:30 Pm I take 2-3 grams of Gabapentin. I cant remember because I usually just took a shit ton. Then I remembered the Focalin I had stashed away, so I took 10mg XR to start. I had 20 more mg.
Ive done coke but never prescription stimulants. I was excited. Coke can be extremely great or bunk but this was prescription uppers. I was so excited
I chewed the Gabapentin and the Focalin as best I could and then waited.  Not even an hour later Im extremely buzzed. I feel like I have no filter. I feel very awake yet also chill? I dont know if the Gabapentin took away any of the negative side effects. I took another 10mg at this point.
10:30 Im talking at a million miles a minute, and feeling extremely confident.  A asked me why I was acting this way and I said I drank a lot of coffee and I was sorry because I knew hed be upset. He doesnt like me drinking coffee because it can make me anxious.
11:00 I decide to tell him my business idea. At the time I thought it was original. It was a spur of the moment idea. My business idea? Selling my dirty underwear and socks online. Again my filter was gone.
I proceeded to talk without any breaks about how great this could be for us. I asked him if he was okay with it, and he said it he was okay. However he did say theres more to just selling your underwear online. Youve got to talk to your customers. Im flying so high and so euphoric. I tell him its an excellent idea since people will pay for used socks and underwear. I also say Im up for talking to customers. I think at this point Ive talked for an hour without breaks.
I think at this point Ive talked for an hour without breaks.
11:45 I want to to take more Focalin so I took the last 10mg plus 600 mg Gabapentin. This combination is definitely amazing. I lay out how I want to do it, and Ive been talking about this for awhile. Suddenly I start to feel a bit restless. I ignored it but it just got worse. I didnt want to give up this extreme euphoria and confidence but about 15 minutes later I just couldnt handle the restlessness. I was upset because Id taken all the Focalin my friend had given me and I also felt a bit depressed. I took 24 mg of Suboxone. I instantly felt more relaxed but I wished the euphoria could go on.
This whole thing just really embarrassed me. Im not embarrassed about wanting to sell underwear, Im just embarrassed because of the way I acted in front of A.  A had at that point known me for 14 years. I had a feeling he knew it wasnt just coffee. So I probably sounded speedy and A knows so well that I have to think he knew.
I did get more Focalin from my friend and did this combination a few more times. At this point
I would space out the Gabapentin more. I can feel weird if I take too much and then take more later.
Overall great experience. I just hoped A didnt feel like I was on legal speed and Gabapentin. He only asked once why I was acting so buzzed.
Gabapentin with
legal speed
seems to take away the anxiety.
